svg.title: Kaplan and Chinchilla compute allocation
svg.desc: Kaplan favors model parameters while Chinchilla balances model parameters and training tokens under the same compute budget.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Two Answers to the Same Compute Budget
How should parameters and training tokens grow?
Compute-optimal is not a data ceiling.
Inference economics can favor spending more training compute on a smaller model.
